    fun k => by
      unfold Nat.Composite
      refine ⟨2, 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · norm_num
      · norm_num

    fun n hn => ⟨0, by
      have h : Nat.gcd n 4 ∣ n := Nat.gcd_dvd_left n 4
